sentences.en: I looked up his telephone number in a telephone directory.
sentences.zh: 我在电话簿上查到了他的电话号码。

sentences.en: You can find her phone number in the directory.
sentences.zh: 你可以在里面找到她的电话号码。

sentences.en: The configuration file for your database server is located in this directory.
sentences.zh: 你的数据库服务器配置文件位于这个目录中。

phrases.zh: 电话簿：指包含电话号码和对应联系人信息的册子或在线资源。

senses.zh: [计] 目录；工商名录；姓名地址录
